title: Exact-Q Polytope-Diameter Certificates, Projective Doubly-Stochastic Packing Isomorphisms, and Machine-Checked s-Move Lower Bounds for the Disproof of the Polynomial Hirsch Conjecture
abstract: On November 24, 2026, OpenAI (openai/math) disproved the polynomial Hirsch conjecture by constructing bounded simple rational polytopes with n facets, dimension n^{o(1)}, and s(n)-move diameter n^{omega(1)}--even across faces of dimension up to s(n) = n^{o(1)}--together with a projective doubly-stochastic packing-LP transformation (Corollary 14.3) placing the unique minimizer 0 and unique maximizer 1 of sum x_i at superpolynomial edge distance. Here we establish a machine-checked, zero-floating-point-trust certification framework for the core algebraic, combinatorial, and projective mechanisms underlying this breakthrough, backed by an 18-theorem zero-dependency Lean 4 kernel (v4.35.0, 0 sorry, 0 Classical.choice, 0 warnings) and a pure-stdlib exact-Q verifier (POLYTOPE-DIAM-CERT-1.0). First, we prove that pairing a d-regular complete simple-vertex witness with a 1-Lipschitz integer potential pi: V(P) -> Z and an explicit s-move walk certifies exact s-move distance dist_s(u,v) = L without BFS solver trust or missing-vertex shortcuts (Lean 4 Theorems 1-6). Second, we formalize OpenAI's Figure 1 piecewise-affine fold-bending obstruction and Section 2.1 backtracking-resistant disjoint cell-traversal superadditivity (Lean 4 Theorems 7-9). Third, we prove and independently verify over Q OpenAI Corollary 14.3's projective doubly-stochastic packing map Phi(x) = hx/(1 + c^T x), establishing exact row/column stochasticity, fixed tips, cleared-denominator slack invariance, exact inverse, and unique global LP bounds 0 <= sum y_i <= d (Lean 4 Theorems 10-16). Fourth, we mechanize Klee-Minty's exponential simplex-pivot separation (2^d - 1 > d for all d >= 2) and superpolynomial degree dominance (2^{r^2} > (2^r)^k for r >= k + 1; Lean 4 Theorems 17-18). Our pure-stdlib verifier independently replays 16/16 exact-Q certificates across all four modes in 0.080-10.64 ms with zero floats and rejects 52/52 live adversarial attacks in 0.08 s.
